A ranger of the deep woods
with a longbow taller than himself.
The longer he draws, the harder it hits -
but up close, he has little to answer with.

A young dragon knight bearing a lance
forged from a dragon's fang.
He breaks every line head-on -
but anything that slips inside his reach
is hard for him to answer.

A warrior with the blood of dragons.
She needs no weapon - claws, tail and fire
sweep everything aside.
Her size makes her easy to hit, but hard to stop.

A swift dual-wielder who chains strikes
together without ever slowing down.
Speed and momentum are her greatest weapons.

A martial artist who fights
with nothing but iron gauntlets.
He must get close - and when you strike first,
he strikes back harder.

Twin pistols, a single sharp line of fire.
She wins the fight before it ever
closes in - but let an enemy through,
and she has no answer for it.

A sorceress who never touches the ground.
She rises and sinks at will,
raining spells on whatever lies below -
but a single blow cuts deep.

An exorcist of a mountain shrine.
She lays ofuda and barriers ahead,
and the path itself turns against her foes -
but she is slow to strike first.

A shinobi who is never where you strike.
She blinks through enemies with a single cut
and is gone before they fall -
but she cannot take many hits.

Clad in silver and gold, she wields a
greatsword said to fell dragons.
Her legend, however, has yet to catch
up with her armor.

A lone swordsman who walks his own path.
No matter how many times he falls,
he rises again - because there is still
a further place to reach.

A noble of the night who needs no blade.
Every wound he deals feeds his blood,
and a long fight only makes him faster -
but he starts every battle hungry.
